meta.name: github-triage
meta.description: Read-only GitHub triage for issues AND PRs. 1 item = 1 background task (category: quick). Analyzes all open items and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim requires a GitHub permalink as proof. NEVER takes any action on GitHub - no comments, no merges, no closes, no labels. Reports only. Triggers: 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析 GitHub 仓库的所有议题和 PR，生成带证据的审阅报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解仓库中所有待办事项的现状和优先级
copy.tagline_en: Analyze all open issues and PRs on GitHub, generating evidence-backed triage reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick overview of all open items in a GitHub repository with evidence

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会读取仓库里所有开启的 issue 和 PR，逐条分类分析，把带 GitHub 永久链接证据的报告写到 /tmp/{时间戳}/ 目录。它全程只读，不评论、不合并、不关闭、不打标签。
howto.when: 当你说「triage」「triage issues」或「github triage」等关键词时触发；每个条目会开一个 quick 后台任务，全部并行处理。

say.text: triage 一下这个仓库所有的 open issue
say.note: 每条开一个后台任务，报告写到 /tmp 时间戳目录

say.text: triage PRs，重点看那些 bugfix 的
say.note: 逐条分析改动正确性与合并就绪度
只读分析，不改动 GitHub 上任何东西

howto.what_en: Claude reads all open issues and PRs, classifies each, and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{timestamp}/. Every claim needs a GitHub permalink. It is read-only: no comments, merges, closes or labels.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "triage", "triage issues", "github triage" and similar. Each item spawns one background quick task, running in parallel.

say_en.text: triage all open issues in this repo
say_en.note: One background task per item; reports land in a /tmp folder

say_en.text: triage the PRs, focus on the bugfix ones
say_en.note: Each PR gets a review and merge-readiness report
Read-only analysis; nothing changes on GitHub
